messages:
olivia_finance: Invoice INV-2026-0899 from NebulaAnalytics (Israel) hit our AP check: vendor is asking us to apply reverse-charge VAT. They gave a VAT number but it doesn't match VIES format. Can tax advise?

dan_procurement: Vendor claim: 'we are an Israeli VAT-registered business, supply of SaaS to foreign entity is reverse-charge. VAT no: IL-514273647'. They attached an invoice PDF and an emailed statement.

rachel_tax: Quick notes: Israel VAT numbers start with 9 digits; the prefix 'IL-' is sometimes used but not required. Reverse charge for cross-border B2B services can apply, but we need: 1) validated VAT ID, 2) contractual UBO/business registration, and 3) evidence of business use (purchase order/PO).

olivia_finance: Pasted invoice snippet: ```
INV-2026-0899
Vendor: NebulaAnalytics LTD
Amount: 8,750.00 USD
VAT: 0 (reverse charge claimed)
VAT ID: IL514273647
```

uri_vendor: Hi Olivia — we sent our VAT cert and Israeli VAT registration extract. Let me know if anything else needed; we do not want VAT charged at source.

rachel_tax: Requesting two things from vendor: (A) a certified copy of the Israeli VAT registration extract (official PDF or link), (B) confirmation of business-to-business nature with Redwood's company number on the doc. Also need PO matching the invoice. If they can't produce, we should not accept reverse-charge and may need to treat as standard VAT.

dan_procurement: I asked vendor to re-upload registration extract to onboarding portal and to reissue invoice with Redwood PO# PO-99021. Sent at 1987654338.

olivia_finance: paybot, flag INV-2026-0899 with TAX_VALIDATE_PENDING and prevent payout until validated.

paybot: action:tax_flag_applied INV-2026-0899 reason=TAX_VALIDATE_PENDING by=olivia_finance at=1987654340

uri_vendor: Uploaded the Israeli VAT extract (pdf) and reissued invoice with PO-99021. Link: https://vendor-uploads.example/nebula/il-extract.pdf

rachel_tax: Received docs. I'll validate the registration extract against Israeli tax authority portal and confirm by EOD. If valid, remove hold and accept reverse-charge. If invalid or mismatched, hold payment and route to legal.

olivia_finance: Thanks team — keeping on hold until tax confirms. Will update invoice status once rachel confirms.
